dryWeight.method: No BMW weight for the M54 was found. BMW's N52 training gives the M54's power-to-weight as "1.0kg/kW" (rounded); x 170 kW = about 170 kg. Cross-check: N52B30 0.82 kg/kW x 190 kW = about 156 kg, plus the stated 10 kg saving = about 166 kg. The rounding of "1.0" alone allows roughly 161-179 kg. It assumes the ratio refers to the 3.0 L M54 and BMW's usual engine-weight definition (not stated). engine-specs.net's 130 kg is inconsistent with BMW's ratios and was not used.

variants.notes: BMW Individual / BMW M "Performance Package" (ZHP), US only: "different camshafts and performance-modified Digital Motor Electronics" (BMW NA). The ZHP cam specifications are not published, so no cam data are stored for this variant.
